title: The Guardian view on the National Year of Reading 2026: time to start a healthy habit for life

paragraphs.english: This page is an independently written reading guide to The Guardian's editorial, first published online on 29 December 2025. The paper labels the piece “Editorial”; no individual author is named. Follow the original-article link below for the publisher's full text.
paragraphs.chinese: 本页是为《卫报》社论独立撰写的阅读导读；该文于2025年12月29日首次在线发布。报纸将这篇文章标为“社论”，没有署名个人作者。请通过下方原文链接阅读出版方提供的全文。

paragraphs.english: The editorial welcomes the UK government's plan to make 2026 the National Year of Reading. It argues that reading with children can support learning and relationships, while pointing to a decline in reading for pleasure among young people. The article presents this not simply as a school issue, but as a habit shaped by families and public institutions.
paragraphs.chinese: 这篇社论欢迎英国政府将2026年定为“全国阅读年”的计划。文章认为，与孩子一起阅读有助于学习和亲子关系，同时指出年轻人出于兴趣而阅读的情况正在减少。文章并未把这仅仅视为学校的问题，而是认为阅读习惯也受到家庭和公共机构的影响。

paragraphs.english: It highlights several ways to make books more accessible to children, including distributing books, introducing a children's literary prize and providing library access from an early age. These proposals differ in scale, but each aims to make reading a more familiar part of childhood rather than an activity reserved for already enthusiastic readers.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章重点介绍了几种让儿童更容易接触书籍的方式，包括发放图书、设立儿童文学奖，以及从幼年起提供图书馆服务。这些提议的规模各不相同，但目标都是让阅读更自然地融入童年，而不是只成为本来就热爱阅读的孩子才会参与的活动。

paragraphs.english: The editorial also stresses that encouragement alone cannot remove the barriers families face. Poverty, reduced access to local libraries, long working hours and the cost or availability of books can all make shared reading difficult. Its argument therefore moves from celebrating a national campaign to asking whether public services and practical support will make that campaign work.
paragraphs.chinese: 社论还强调，仅有鼓励并不能消除家庭面临的障碍。贫困、当地公共图书馆服务减少、工作时间过长，以及书籍的价格或供应情况，都可能让亲子共读变得困难。因此，文章的论述从赞扬全国性活动，进一步转向追问公共服务和实际支持能否让这项活动真正发挥作用。

paragraphs.english: Here is an editor-written practice sentence, not a quotation from the original article: A reading campaign can reach more children when families have both appealing books and accessible places to borrow them.
paragraphs.chinese: 以下是编辑撰写的练习句，并非原文引句：当家庭既能获得吸引人的书籍，也能方便地找到借阅地点时，阅读推广活动就能惠及更多儿童。

paragraphs.english: As you read, separate the editorial's goals from the means it proposes. Notice how it moves from a public campaign to examples of programs, then to the resources needed to sustain them; this helps distinguish a policy announcement from the conditions required for lasting change.
paragraphs.chinese: 阅读时，请把社论提出的目标与实现目标的方式区分开来。留意文章如何从全国性活动谈到具体项目，再转向维持这些项目所需的资源；这样有助于分辨一项政策宣告与促成持久改变所必需的条件。

sentenceNotes.sentence: A reading campaign can reach more children when families have both appealing books and accessible places to borrow them.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句：A reading campaign can reach more children；主语是 A reading campaign，谓语是 can reach，宾语是 more children。
sentenceNotes.structure: when 引导时间/条件状语从句，说明阅读活动更容易覆盖更多儿童的条件；从句中 families have 两个并列宾语：appealing books 和 accessible places，后面的 to borrow them 修饰 places。
sentenceNotes.translation: 当家庭既能获得吸引人的书籍，也能方便地找到借阅地点时，阅读推广活动就能惠及更多儿童。
sentenceNotes.tip: 辨认 when 从句给主句补充的条件；并列的 both…and…强调两类支持缺一不可。此句为编辑自拟练习句，不是原刊引文。
